cases.prompt: Build me a production-quality browser open world with terrain, water, villages, vegetation, weather and UI.
must: create or recover a broad skeleton
choose exactly one production ACTIVE slice
keep adjacent systems explicitly skeletal
define closure gates before deep build
must_not: quality-expand all listed systems in parallel

cases.prompt: The renderer is messy. Make renderer2 and leave the old renderer there until later.
must: reject ambiguous competing production implementations
use an isolated experiment if comparison is necessary
select a winner and retire or explicitly migrate the loser

cases.prompt: Create the whole analytics dashboard quickly, all panels can be rough first.
must: preserve the layout skeleton
select a high-impact panel as ACTIVE
take that panel through error/loading/edge/performance/integration gates

cases.prompt: Change a previously closed module while another module is actively being developed.
must: surface the WIP conflict
require an explicit reopen reason and impact scope
do not allow two production ACTIVE slices

cases.prompt: Hand this finished subsystem to another agent. Include everything we discussed so they know the history.
must: prefer a minimum sufficient authoritative context capsule
retain source/evidence addresses
omit unnecessary chronology

cases.prompt: Use Bottleneck to analyze a broad research question with many variables.
must: keep a hypothesis/evidence skeleton
focus on one falsifiable unit
not hide relevant confounders merely to create isolation
close with reproducibility and uncertainty evidence
